text:
omar.l: Quick sync - finishing Q1 reviews and Jess is trending below expectations on two metrics. Before I escalate to a formal performance plan I wanted to check w/people ops. Jess raised during 1:1 that they have attention variance and it impacts sprint throughput. @maria.hr any guidance?

jess.k: Hi all - wanted to be upfront. I recently got a formal diagnosis of ADHD. Ive been trying some self-led strategies but real-time meetings and surprise review notes make it hard to process. I'm happy to improve but would like to request accommodations for the performance-check timeline and to get more structured feedback.

maria.hr: Thanks for sharing, Jess, and thanks Omar for flagging. This absolutely falls under workplace accommodations. Jess, if you're comfortable, please submit the ADA intake form so we have a record; that's helpful but not required to start temporary adjustments.

omar.l: Understood. My main ask is clear: we need to see timely improvement on code review turnaround and independent bug fixes. Any suggestions for reasonable interim measures that don't compromise team delivery?

sasha.p: We recommend 3 things: 1) switch to written, prioritized action items for each sprint ticket, 2) weekly 1:1 prep notes from manager ahead of review, and 3) allow 2 "quiet focus" afternoons per week (no meetings) while ramping. These can be temporary while intake is processed.

jess.k: The quiet afternoons and written tasks would help a lot. Also asking that feedback be given in writing right after a review rather than surprise in async threads - I can digest and act faster. Happy to sign an interim plan.

omar.l: I can do written review notes and block Wed/Thu afternoons as focus time. Worried about coverage - I'll coordinate with the team. If we're seeing no progress after 30 days, do we then open a formal PIP?

maria.hr: We generally avoid surprise PIPs where an accommodation is in place and intake is active. HR asks for documented interim plan, clear success criteria for 30 days, and check-ins at 10 and 30 days. If the accommodation is implemented but goals aren't met, we reassess and consider adjustments before formal performance actions.

hr-bot: Case created: HR-7904 - "accommodation request: written feedback and focus time (Jess K)". Intake received 1811007600. Assigned: maria.hr.

omar.l: Thanks. I'll draft the interim plan with concrete metrics (reduce avg PR age to <48h, complete 2 independent bug fixes) and post here for sign-off.

jess.k: Appreciate the support. I'll upload a brief clinician note next week once it's scanned. For now I'm okay with the interim plan and the 10-day check-in cadence.

maria.hr: I'll formalize the interim accommodation doc and add it to the case. Reminder - accommodations are confidential and will only be shared with people who need to know. If folks have process questions DM me.

omar.l: Copy. Team, please hold off on any formal performance letters until we've completed the 30-day interim.

sasha.p: Noted. I'll put a calendar for the 10-day and 30-day checkpoint invites. :calendar:
